## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与改动效果

Describe the concrete user problem, the trigger, and the behavior after this change.

## Scope and data impact / 范围与数据影响

- Affected analysis or execution route:
- Any change to eligible files, protected boundaries, command scope, or retention:
- Recovery or retrieval implications:

## Validation / 验证

List the commands or suites run, platform and tool versions, results, and any failures or skips. Distinguish simulations, real fixtures, and untested platforms. Use fictional data only.

## Review / 检查

- [ ] This contribution is within the described scope and does not add implicit user authorization.
- [ ] Protected data, shared ownership, identities, and uncertain or partial outcomes have been considered.
- [ ] New or changed executable behavior has meaningful success and refusal tests, or this PR changes documentation only.
- [ ] Applicable instructions, references, and verification limits are updated without overstating validation.
- [ ] No secrets, sessions, indexes, databases, customer files, raw personal reports, or private absolute paths are included.
- [ ] I have permission to share the contribution and preserved any required third-party notices.

Security-sensitive findings belong in the private route in the [security policy](https://github.com/SoberAming/codex-project-storage/security/policy), not in a public PR description.
